title: Auto Pick Up Egg, Auto Hatch , Auto Feed and more
features:
The "Ride A Pet" script, operated through the ZD Hub interface, provides an extensive automation suite designed to efficiently farm eggs and acquire highly rare pets. The script is optimized to streamline the core gameplay loop of collecting, hatching, and placing eggs to maximize in-game earnings.
Core Automation Features:
 * Auto Farm Loop: Automates the complete gameplay cycle by tweening the player to an egg, picking it up, hatching it, tweening back to the baseplate, and placing the egg.
 * Select Rarity: Includes a filtering system that allows users to target specific eggs and pets based on their rarity tiers.
 * Rollback Egg: Optimizes farming by repeatedly picking up and hatching the same egg before returning to base, as long as that egg remains active.
 * Auto Pickup (Standalone): Continuously collects any nearby active eggs without initiating the tweening movement sequence.
Movement and Configuration Settings:
 * Travel and Return Times: Users can precisely configure the travel duration to an egg (defaulting to 5 seconds) and set a maximum travel duration for returning to the baseplate (defaulting to 3 seconds).
 * Custom Speeds: The script allows customization of both the "Tween Speed" when traveling to eggs and the "Return Speed" back to the base, measured in studs per second.
